Carlos Morales
Senior Mobile Application Engineer
San Diego, CA | carlos.morales@mobiledev.io | +1 619-555-0163 | linkedin.com/in/carlosmorales-mobile | github.com/carlosmorales-apps

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Mobile Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and shipping high-performance iOS and Android applications using React Native, Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript. Expert in cross-platform mobile architecture, offline-first data synchronization, performance profiling, and CI/CD mobile release automation. Shipped 8 flagship mobile apps with a combined 4.8+ App Store rating and over 5M total downloads.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Mobile Software Engineer | FitPulse Health | San Diego, CA | 2021 - Present
- Led mobile engineering team in developing cross-platform React Native fitness app with 2M+ active users and 4.9 App Store rating.
- Implemented native bridge modules in Swift and Kotlin for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) health device telemetry, reducing data sync latency by 50%.
- Optimized app launch time from 2.8s to 0.9s and reduced memory footprint by 35% using Hermes engine and re-render optimizations.
- Built automated mobile CI/CD pipeline using Fastlane and GitHub Actions, reducing release cycle time from 10 days to 24 hours.
- Integrated Apple HealthKit, Google Fit, and in-app subscription monetization with RevenueCat, driving $4.2M in annual recurring revenue.

Mobile App Developer | UrbanGo Mobility | Los Angeles, CA | 2018 - 2021
- Developed native iOS application features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine, maintaining 99.8% crash-free session rate across 1.5M users.
- Created real-time GPS navigation and ride-hailing tracking using Mapbox SDK and WebSockets with sub-second driver updates.
- Refactored state management to Redux Toolkit and SQLite persistence, enabling full offline functionality for mobile riders.
- Collaborated with UX designers to implement fluid custom gestures, micro-interactions, and dark mode support.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | San Diego State University | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Mobile Platforms & Frameworks: React Native, iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), TypeScript, JavaScript
- Mobile Tools & SDKs: Xcode, Android Studio, Fastlane, CocoaPods, Gradle, Expo, Mapbox, Bluetooth LE, HealthKit, Firebase
- State & Data Management: Redux Toolkit, React Query, Zustand, SQLite, WatermelonDB, Realm, GraphQL, REST APIs
- Testing & Quality: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, Appium, Sentry, Datadog Mobile RUM, Crashlytics
- Architecture: MVVM, Clean Architecture, Offline-First Sync, Modular Component Systems, Git

CERTIFICATIONS
- Meta Certified React Native Specialist (2022)
- Apple Certified iOS App Developer (2020)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Senior Mobile Engineer to build our next-generation consumer apps. Requirements:
- 5+ years of mobile engineering experience with React Native, Swift, or Kotlin.
- Proven experience shipping consumer mobile applications on Apple App Store and Google Play.
- Experience with Bluetooth LE, real-time data sync, state management, and mobile CI/CD (Fastlane).
- Strong knowledge of mobile performance optimization, crash monitoring, and offline persistence.
